name: Microgrid grid-forming reference selection
summary: Selects the available source assigned to establish the island voltage and frequency reference.
description: Selects the available source assigned to establish the island voltage and frequency reference. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Grid-forming resource availability” at the input and “Selected island reference” at the output. Reference transfer requires a validated control scheme.
